question: What was ordered quantity per order for the full year 2025? Use the recorded order date for the 2025 scope.

action.answer: For the full year 2025 (using recorded order date), the average ordered quantity per order was 2.805393 items. This means that, on average, each order placed in 2025 contained about 2.81 items (rounded to two decimals). Population: all orders in 2025. Unit: items per order. Interpretation: Customers typically ordered just under three items per order throughout 2025.
